newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican officials sought in case of missing cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Mexican officials sought in case of missing cocaine.

text.p: A Mexican judge has issued arrest warrants for nine more people, including some federal agents, in the case of half a tonne of cocaine that went missing from police custody, authorities said on Wednesday.
Of the 15 suspects in the case so far, nine are federal agents, two active-duty army soldiers, one a federal official and three civilians, the Attorney General's Office said.
On May 21, nearly half a tonne of cocaine disappeared from the Federal Judicial Police headquarters in San Luis Colorado near the Arizona border.
The missing cocaine was one of the starker examples of corruption in Mexico's anti-drug forces, which have faced a series of embarrassing scandals in recent months.
The nine new suspects are wanted on a host of charges, including drug trafficking and criminal association.
All of the suspects remain at large.
